policy.A1_B: Use saved top_parents parent_id order, not saved selected chunks. Preserve original upstream_status; non-ok propagates. No new ranking/embedding/reranking.
policy.C_E: From newly packed successful B selected IDs, call scripts.graphrag_expand.expand independently with adjacency for C and sqlite for E: max_depth=1,max_candidates=32,max_evidence_bytes=64000. Preserve expansion failure; do not turn it into success by truncation. For successful expansion pack only first8 candidate IDs in returned order, record later exclusions. Same common pack_base. Compare C/E candidates/status/selected chunks, do not overwrite mismatches.
policy.D: Generate fresh shacl_binding from successful exact C envelope with frozen shapes, inference none, no imports/advanced; retain Python parity and RDF/text artifacts. On parity failure preserve original report and mark validation_execution_error, no repair. Compact by removing only python_results and parity; account_report consumes exact C. D failure never removes C/E.
policy.runtime: tokenizers0.22.1 no padding/truncation, pinned E5 bytes. Counter only serialized full messages, generator_ready always false. pyshacl0.40.1 rdflib7.6.0; runtime versions recorded. PYTHONOPTIMIZE=0.
policy.failures: Plan24x5 rows before loop; each arm error recorded, upstream B failure propagates C/E/D but does not discard A1. Per-question/arm runtime exceptions retained; no model calls or automatic retry.
policy.run_gate: This is candidate preparation only. New runner code must be frozen/reviewed and manifest rebound with its digest before execution; no execution authorized by this manifest alone.
policy.limits: Future run: 120seconds outer timeout,2GiB address cap; interrupted rows remain unprocessed with original planned IDs. No performance claim.
policy.scorer: No scorer/reference/answer files in runtime. Later support evaluation separate unchanged offline scorer. No gold repair.
policy.new_directory: common-budget-off-001; never overwrite previous runs. Anchor-on later separate fresh run/review.
